vep_command: vep -i variants.vcf -o <out> --offline --cache --dir_cache <cache> --cache_version 116 --species homo_sapiens --assembly GRCh38 --format vcf --buffer_size 5000 --fork 1 --fasta reference.fa --stats_text --quiet --force_overwrite --refseq [--tab|--vcf|--json]
fasta: GRCh38 chromosome 21 at its full length from Homo_sapiens.GRCh38.dna.primary_assembly.fa, every base outside the regions a run reads (each cached transcript's span with 5,000 bases of flank and each record with 2,000) masked to N; reference.fa.gz beside this file, compressed with bgzip, with reference.fa.gz.fai and reference.fa.gz.gzi for the compressed file and reference.fa.fai for its decompressed form; Ensembl VEP received the decompressed file as --fasta on every run
input: variants.vcf: 40 chromosome 21 records of gnomAD v4.1 genomes and the 1000 Genomes high-coverage call set, chromosome 21, sites only, each an exemplar of a consequence-set combination or of a stratum of the family key REFSEQ_MATCH=,BAM_EDIT=,REFSEQ_OFFSET,GIVEN_REF/USED_REF in Ensembl VEP's output over the candidate records (the RefSeq models' columns, with --hgvs for REFSEQ_OFFSET); records inside the genomic bases an RNA edit deletes from a model and records whose alternate allele is the base an RNA edit substitutes (Ensembl VEP spells their HGVSc as a change of a base to itself) are left out; the records lie in 1 Mb cache regions no two of which hold distinct aligned-transcript models under one stable id, since Ensembl VEP de-duplicates a buffer's models by stable id (AnnotationType/Transcript.pm:313-343 at release/116.3) and would otherwise drop one of them from the --all_refseq run

source_cache.tarball: homo_sapiens_refseq_vep_116_GRCh38.tar.gz under pub/release-116/variation/indexed_vep_cache/ of the Ensembl FTP site

converter.build: the release build of the tree this corpus is committed with

source_cache.rseq_attributes: none: no model of the release 116 RefSeq or merged cache carries an rseq_* attribute, so REFSEQ_MATCH is empty on every row of both engines

pruned_cache.method: scripts/golden/prune_json_cache.py --gzip --drop sorted_exons --drop protein_features --drop protein_function_predictions --flank 5000 over the converted chromosome 21 of the source cache; info.json is the converted cache's own (source_type, bam and the source versions)

generator: Ensembl VEP 116.2 over the candidate records under --refseq --hgvs; tools/vep-golden-corpus select --release 116 --assembly GRCh38 --dataset <id>=<reference>=<candidates> (two datasets) --k 1 --seed 1 --multi-allelic-per-dataset 1 --max-span 1000000 --cache <converted cache> --flank 5000 --family-columns REFSEQ_MATCH=,BAM_EDIT=,REFSEQ_OFFSET,GIVEN_REF/USED_REF --covers ... --matrix tests/parity/matrix.tsv --flag=--refseq --fasta-name reference.fa.gz; scripts/golden/prune_json_cache.py (see pruned_cache); the FASTA masked as scripts/fixtures/cut_plugin_regions.py masks a reference; tools/vep-golden-corpus flag-set (one per set: all-refseq (--refseq --all_refseq); hgvs (--refseq --hgvs); exclude-predicted (--refseq --exclude_predicted); given-ref (--refseq --use_given_ref); gene-symbol-id (--refseq --transcript_filter _gene_symbol_id)); scripts/concordance/generate_reference_output.sh --corpus (the manifest's run and --flag-set <name> for each set); tools/vep-golden-corpus classify (the manifest's run and each set)
